known_issue.description: A continuous slice of a country/ASN-sorted task list caused successful measurements to cluster in three RU ASNs; KZ/BY probes were not adequately represented. The first-run reachability totals are exploratory only.
known_issue.required_fix: Stratified/round-robin selection across (country, ASN) providers; first give each provider a complete DNS A/AAAA + HTTPS IPv4/IPv6 target bundle, then allocate additional target bundles; deterministically rotate providers and targets by UTC date.
